`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_selected;
    wire [15:0] local_winner [0:15];
    wire [3:0] local_code [0:15];
    wire [15:0] low_bit_terms [0:3];
    wire [3:0] low_code;
    wire [3:0] high_code;

    genvar g, j, b;
    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
        if (g == 15) begin : top_group
            assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g];
        end else begin : lower_group
            assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g] & ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end

        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : bits_in_group
            if (j == 15) begin : top_bit
                assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j];
            end else begin : lower_bit
                assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j]
                    & ~(|input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : zero_default
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] =
                    (group_selected[g] & local_winner[g][j]) | ~output_valid;
            end else begin : ordinary_output
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] =
                    group_selected[g] & local_winner[g][j];
            end
        end

        assign local_code[g][0] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hAAAA);
        assign local_code[g][1] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hCCCC);
        assign local_code[g][2] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hF0F0);
        assign local_code[g][3] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hFF00);
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : code_terms
            assign low_bit_terms[b][g] = group_selected[g] & local_code[g][b];
        end
    end

    for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : low_reductions
        assign low_code[b] = |low_bit_terms[b];
    end
    assign high_code[0] = |(group_selected & 16'hAAAA);
    assign high_code[1] = |(group_selected & 16'hCCCC);
    assign high_code[2] = |(group_selected & 16'hF0F0);
    assign high_code[3] = |(group_selected & 16'hFF00);
    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign output_encoded = {high_code, low_code};
end else begin : original_parameter_fallback
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate

endmodule
`resetall

    "invalid_case": "Explicitly assert output_unencoded[0] when output_valid is zero. The encoded reductions naturally produce zero on an all-zero input.",

    },
    "nonzero_inputs": "Exactly one group_selected bit identifies the highest nonempty group. Within that group, exactly one local_winner bit identifies its highest set input. Their conjunction therefore selects the globally highest set index, and both encodings describe that same index.",
    "zero_input": "All group selections and local winners are zero, so output_valid=0 and output_encoded=0. The explicit default term produces output_unencoded=256'b1, matching the original.",
    "restrictions": "Pure combinational Verilog with no clocks, state, assumptions, input restrictions, don't-cares, or masked invalid outputs. All 256 binary inputs remain unrestricted, and equivalence must cover every output bit even when valid is zero."
